campaign_design.specificity_gates: all_walk seeds with any sidestep signature in either control window <= 1/8; all_walk seeds with any step event <= 1/8

decision_rule.note: Rules are evaluated in order; in-between counts report no binary verdict at n=8. A verdict is scientifically valid only when every preregistered gate passed.

squeeze_52 sidestep >= 4/8 and step_52 step event <= 1/8

execution_mode.note: Dependency injection exists for CPU tests; any injected run is explicitly non-evidentiary. Production constructs the ARDY runner only after the empty evidence bundle is durable.

handoff_transmission.definition: RMS over 96 post-switch frames (52..147) and all joint coordinates qpos[:, 7:] of the per-frame joint-angle difference between two arms of the same seed
handoff_transmission.inference: descriptive only; no interval or test is claimed

summary.inference: planned-denominator rates with Wilson 95% intervals; paired counts across arms; descriptive at n=8; no interval is claimed on any paired difference
